label: Clear joy
lyrics: I'm alive, I'm free, dancing in the sunshine. Beautiful day, hopeful heart, smile so bright. Happy now, blessed and alive, joy is all I know.

label: Romantic love
lyrics: Love so sweet it fills my heart, beautiful you, blessed dream. Hold me close, alive in your arms, hope and light forever.

label: Triumphant freedom
lyrics: Free at last, alive and bright, dancing through the heaven of the day. Run and jump and rock the world, beautiful, amazing, free.

label: Peaceful hope
lyrics: Peace, peace, sweet peace, hope and light returning. Blessed quiet day, beautiful sunshine warm, dream of better tomorrow.

label: Celebration
lyrics: Dance and shout and rock the night, happy, alive, amazing. Wonderful, beautiful, sweet sweet life, smile and love and hope.

label: Sunrise hope
lyrics: Sunshine breaks through, hope returns, alive again. Beautiful morning, sweet light, blessed and free. Bright dream, smile through the dawn.

label: Soft love
lyrics: Love light shining sweet on you, beautiful in the soft glow. Hope alive between us, dream of forever, blessed every day.

label: Empowered
lyrics: Alive, alive, alive, rock and shake and run, free at last. Beautiful fight, amazing strength, bright light leading.

label: Grateful
lyrics: Blessed, blessed, blessed, happy heart, joy filling. Beautiful gift, sweet hope, alive and free and great.

label: Bright optimism
lyrics: Bright tomorrow, hope and light, dream that never dies. Beautiful sunshine, sweet alive, amazing peace and free.
